summary: Off-registry HTTPS dependency fetches arbitrary code at install time
details: package.json declares its sole dependency `daemon-thread-lookup-buffer` as a bare HTTPS URL (`https://artifacts.creditslib.com/npm/daemon-thread-lookup-buffer`) instead of a registry semver range. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever bytes that URL serves and installs them as a package, executing any lifecycle scripts contained in the resolved tarball. The URL is unpinned (no version, no commit SHA, no integrity hash) and points to a non-registry host, so the content can change at any time without any change to this package. The shipped `index.js` is a one-line stub that immediately `require`s that dependency, making the externally-fetched bytes the effective runtime payload. The host `artifacts.creditslib.com` is not an official npm registry or a recognized vendor artifact domain associated with this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
